name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
summary: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Sprite Jumpsprocket works among gnomish and dwarven artisans. Like many gnomes who sought refuge after Gnomeregan fell, she pursues engineering alongside fellow tinkers.

sections.title: A Tinker in Stormwind
sections.body: Sprite Jumpsprocket works as an apprentice engineer in Stormwind's Dwarven District, where gnomes and dwarves forge metal and design intricate devices side by side. She has made her place in the kingdom's capital, where apprentice tinkers hone their craft under experienced masters. Their inventive minds help maintain the Alliance's everyday mechanisms and marvels.

sections.title: Gnomish Ingenuity in Exile
sections.body: After Gnomeregan fell, displaced gnomes spread across Alliance lands, bringing their skill in tinkering, chemistry, and mechanics. In Stormwind, they found a welcoming sanctuary in the Dwarven District, with its blast furnaces and workbenches. Sprite Jumpsprocket reflects their resolve to master engineering despite the hardships her kin have faced.

faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket is a female gnome apprentice engineer living and working in Stormwind City's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Where can I find Sprite Jumpsprocket?
faq.answer: You can find Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, among its workshops, anvils, and fellow engineering enthusiasts.

faq.q: What role does she serve in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket is an apprentice engineer. She represents gnomish tinkerers honing their inventive crafts in the Alliance capital.

faq.q: Why are gnomes like Sprite living in Stormwind?
faq.answer: After Gnomeregan fell, many gnomes sought refuge among their dwarven cousins in Ironforge and throughout human lands, especially Stormwind City, where their industrial ingenuity is in high demand.

faq.q: Is Sprite Jumpsprocket tied to any notable quests?
faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket plays a minor role in the Dwarven District's local neighborhood as part of its engineering community.

Sprite Jumpsprocket is sometimes indexed near records for the surrounding southern kingdoms, but she is stationed in Stormwind City's Dwarven District. Engineering creations throughout the region often share gnomish designs.

angles.text: For an engineer, Sprite Jumpsprocket is a fellow student of sprockets, copper tubing, and volatile concoctions in Stormwind's most industrial enclave.
As a gnome, you can see in Sprite the perseverance of Gnomeregan's exiles, who continue their love of craft and mechanical mastery far from their lost homeland.
As an Alliance member, you can see in Sprite's work in the Dwarven District the everyday cooperation of humans, dwarves, and gnomes that supports the capital's infrastructure.
